provenance.note: Rows are the sidecar usage log as the harness read it. The file on disk ended up with 157 agent rows; the 157th (ts 06:45:23) was appended after this snapshot, by post-agent traffic from the still-running container.
provenance.image_row_evidence: The four image-tool rows were pinned by mapping the trajectory narrative clock onto sidecar UTC (constant faketime offset within the opening segment): the four image toolResults land within 0.15s of these rows. Each carries cache_read_tokens 0 (buildImageContext sends a fresh single-message context), two hit the 4096-token cap resolveImageToolMaxTokens defaults to, and cache_write tracks image count (3/3/3/6 images -> 12310/11839/11839/23469).

agent_finished.note: The harness log records the finish to the second, so the boundary recoverable from THIS run is the end of that second: later than the run's last turn row (06:45:14.589689) and 8.25s earlier than the row that arrived after the snapshot (06:45:23.253404). A live run does not need the rounding — runner.py stamps time.time() the instant the agent process returns and carries it to the attribution as __agent_finished_ts__.

channels.note: usage_oauth.jsonl is the OAuth bridge channel: chat completions only, with the startup probe recorded as an ordinary agent row and no embeddings row at all. Including the probe and excluding embeddings makes the two logs identical, which is the reconciliation extract_usage_from_litellm_log documents.
